environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions workflow. Runtime: python3.9 on Amazon Linux 2. Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject and states:SendTaskSuccess. Container runs as sbx_user1 with default Lambda sandbox (no additional MAC policies). /var/cache/docproc is writable. Step Functions input is received from API Gateway with no input validation or JSONPath filtering on the state machine definition. The state machine uses a Pass state that forwards raw API input to the transform step.
